# GlowUP.

> GlowUP. is the AI-powered salon operating system. Glo, the AI receptionist, books the live multi-stylist calendar after hours. The same OS runs CRM, deposits, and growth as the floor adds chairs.

GlowUP. is for salon owners (solo booth through multi-location floors), not for guests looking to book a haircut. Open beta. Chat Glo is live; phone voice is coming.

## Product

- Site: https://glowupbeautysolutions.com
- Flagship: Glo — AI chat front desk that books the live book (not a voicemail, not a bolt-on widget)
- Also: live multi-stylist calendar, client CRM, deposits, Glow Agents (Fill the Book, Chair Content, Reputation, Front Desk)
- Wordmark: GlowUP. (period is part of the name)
- Slogan: Beauty Business, Beautifully Done.

## Pricing (also /pricing.md)

- Solo: $39/mo — 1 stylist, 150 Glo conversations
- Floor: $149/mo — multi-stylist, one location, 1,000 Glo conversations (most salons)
- Brand: $299+/location/mo — multi-location, custom
- 14-day trial on Solo and Floor. Not per-seat. AI included in every paid plan.
- vs booking software + a separate AI receptionist ($49–200+/mo)

## Who it is for

- Primary: owners of multi-stylist floors
- Also: solo / booth stylists who will add chairs
- Not: guests booking a haircut; owners who want fully autonomous social posting with no approval

## Honest limits

- Open beta. Do not cite fake salon counts.
- Homepage inquiry→book ranges are industry-modeled, not GlowUP. audited results.
- Social is assist / human-approve first. Auto-post is not live.
